entities.summary: Marc Goossens, nicknamed "the Goose", is a Belgian professional racing driver that currently competes in the NASCAR Whelen Euro Series, priorly driving the No. 14 Chevrolet Camaro for SpeedHouse in the EuroNASCAR PRO class. He is now driving the No. He also currently manages 2022 and 2023 World Rally Champion Kalle Rovanperä in his road racing exploits.
